svg.title: W06: Manager coordination collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Workflow · A² A1 · hub role collaboration
Keep a coordinating agent in control of specialists.
A manager remains responsible while specialists
The manager delegates, selects, or calls a
The manager synthesizes specialist outputs and
Delegation does not transfer final goal
is resolved or surfaced by the manager.
1 select(capability) → 2 return(specialist) → 3 delegate(task) → 4 dispatch(task) → 5 return(result) → 6 synthesize(results)
Evidence: 28/41 repositories, 27/36 families; 28 trajectories (12 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Hierarchical Crew, supervisor, coordinator, and manager-agent patterns.
Negative control: A coordinator that merely launches tasks without integration is W04.
